files.text:
# Robo-Garage controller PCB v1.3

100 × 100 mm, 2 layers, 1 oz copper, all parts on top. Made with KiCad 7 + Freerouting (FOSS). DRC: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 unconnected.
**Every BOM line has an LCSC number (all in stock, checked 3 Nov 2026) → JLCPCB assembles the whole board (SMD + clamps, sockets, fan header). You only plug in the DevKitC.**

**New in v1.3: power headroom**
| Area | v1.2 | v1.3 |
|---|---|---|
| 12 V input | 3 A, 2-pole clamp, PTC 2.6 A, AO3407A | **6 A**, 4-pole clamp (2 × 12V, 2 × GND), PTC 7 A (2920), P-FET AO4407C (11.5 mΩ), TVS SMAJ15A |
| Actuator | DRV8871, limit 1.9 A | **DRV8874** (6 A peak), current limit **4.9 A** (R5 = 1.5 kΩ), 3 A moves |
| Motor current | 0.1 Ω shunt, INA219 range 3.2 A | 20 mΩ / 2 W shunt with Kelvin taps, INA219 range 8 A |
| Valve | AO3400A, PTC 1.5 A → max 1.2 A | **IRLTS6342** (30 V, 8.3 A), PTC 4 A (1812) → **max 3 A** |
| 12 V aux | direct from the rail | own PTCs: F7 1.1 A (fan, beam, leak), F8 0.2 A (button LED) |
| LED 5 V | PTC 1.5 A | PTC 2 A |
| T/H sensor | SHT40 | SHT41 (same footprint, address 0x44) |
| Copper | 1.0–1.5 mm | every power path checked against IPC-2221 (table below) |

## Limits (also printed on the back)
| Output | Limit | Protection |
|---|---|---|
| 12 V IN | 6 A continuous (board ≤ 40 °C). PSU 12 V / 5 A recommended, a 3 A PSU still works | F1 PTC 7 A hold / 14 A trip, reverse-polarity P-FET, TVS 15 V |
| ACTUATOR | 3 A moving, **4.9 A hardware limit** | DRV8874 current regulation + over-current + thermal shutdown, INA219 stall stop (firmware) |
| VALVE | 12 V, **3 A** continuous, inductive OK | F4 PTC 4 A hold (≈ 3.2 A at 50 °C), SS34 flyback |
| LED 5 V | 1.5 A (16 WS2812 at full white ≈ 1 A) | F2 PTC 2 A |
| 5 V rail total | 3 A | LMR51430 current limit + hiccup |
| FAN + BEAM + LEAK 12 V | 1.1 A together | F7 1.1 A, F3 / F5 0.2 A per sensor feed |
| BUTTON LED 12 V | 0.2 A | F8 0.2 A |
| LEAK 3V3 | 50 mA | F6 0.2 A (shares the DevKit regulator) |
| Clamps | 5 A per pole, 0.2–0.75 mm² | – |

## Copper check (IPC-2221, outer layer, 1 oz)
DC network solve over every track and via of each power net, current = the limit above. Need = IPC-2221 width for ≤ 20 °C rise.
| Path | Current | Copper (narrowest) | Need | Drop |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12V IN → F1 → Q1 | 7 A | 3.0 / 4.2 mm | 2.9 mm | 21 mV |
| Q1 → shunt (west trunk) | 4.9 A | 2.0 mm | 1.8 mm | 81 mV |
| Q1 → valve PTC (east branch) | 4 A | 2.0 mm | 1.3 mm | 21 mV |
| Shunt → DRV8874 VM | 4.9 A | 2.0 mm | 1.8 mm | 67 mV |
| DRV8874 → ACTUATOR clamp | 4.9 A | 1.8 mm (spots ≤ 5 mm long: 1.5–1.7 mm) | 1.8 mm | 46 / 64 mV |
| VALVE 12V / VLV | 4 A | 1.5 mm | 1.3 mm | 21 / 20 mV |
| Buck input | 1.5 A | 0.8 mm | 0.4 mm | 29 mV |
| 5 V buck → LED clamp | 2 A | 0.8 mm | 0.5 mm | 92 mV |
| Aux 12 V (fan, beam, leak) | 1.1 A | 0.6 mm | 0.2 mm | 42 mV |
| Vias in power paths | ≤ 1.1 A | 0.4–0.6 mm drill | 1.3 A per via | – |

Pin necks: 0.4–0.6 mm for ≤ 1.4 mm at the 0.65 mm-pitch DRV8874 pins and the buck SW pin (set by the pin pitch; the wide copper starts right after the pad).
At 4.9 A the 1.5 mm spots run ≈ 26 °C above ambient when held for minutes; a door move takes ≤ 15 s.

## Part checks (datasheets)
| Part | Check | OK |
|---|---|---|
| DRV8874PWPR (U1) | VM 4.5–37 V, 6 A peak, 200 mΩ HS+LS. 3 A → 1.8 W for ≤ 15 s per move; a stall at 4.9 A ends in the firmware stall stop or the driver's thermal shutdown | ✓ |
| LMR51430XFDDCR (U4) | 500 kHz FPWM, 4.5–36 V in, 3 A. TI 12 → 5 V example: 6.8 µH + 44 µF → board: 6.8 µH (Isat 6 A) + 3 × 22 µF. EN tied to VIN through 100 k (allowed) | ✓ |
| INA219 (U2) | Bus ≤ 26 V; the TVS keeps surges ≤ 24.4 V | ✓ |
| IRLTS6342 (Q6) | 30 V, 8.3 A, Vgs ±12 V (driven at 3.3 V): 0.2 W at 3 A | ✓ |
| AO4407C (Q1) | 30 V, 14 A, Vgs ±25 V (BZT52C12 clamps it to 12 V): 0.4 W at 6 A | ✓ |
| R6 20 mΩ 2 W | 0.48 W at 4.9 A | ✓ |
| R44 10 Ω 1206 | ≈ 0.19 W while the buzzer sounds (0.25 W part) | ✓ |
| Electrolytics | C1 / C3 25 V on 12 V, C13 16 V on 5 V | ✓ |
| PTCs | voltage rating ≥ rail: F1 24 V, F4 16 V, F3/F5–F8 30 V on 12 V; F2 12 V on 5 V | ✓ |

## Files
| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `robo-garage_gerbers_JLCPCB.zip` | Upload at JLCPCB (PCB) |
| `robo-garage_BOM_JLCPCB.csv`, `robo-garage_CPL_JLCPCB.csv` | PCB Assembly: BOM + pick & place (48 lines, 114 parts) |
| `pin1-check.png` | Intended orientation of every polarised part: compare with JLC's placement preview |
| `robo-garage-pcb.yaml` | ESPHome config for this board |
| `kicad/` | KiCad project to edit later |
| `render_top.png`, `render_bottom.png` | Pictures |

## Order at JLCPCB
| Step | Setting |
|---|---|
| 1 PCB | Upload the gerbers zip → 2 layers, 1.6 mm, LeadFree HASL, **1 oz**, via covering *Tented*, "Mark on PCB": default. The C-shaped slot around the SHT41 (bottom right) is intended (heat isolation): confirm if JLC asks |
| 2 Assembly | **Economic**, top side, 2 boards, **Tooling holes: Added by Customer** (TH1–TH3 are on the board), *Confirm Parts Placement* = yes |
| 3 Files | Upload BOM + CPL. Parts list: all 48 lines must match by LCSC number (0 "no part selected") |
| 4 THT | The clamps, the 3 sockets and the fan header are THT: keep them ticked → JLC solders them (≈ $3.5 + $0.02 per joint, 96 joints per board) |
| 5 Preview | Compare the placement preview with **`pin1-check.png`**. New footprints in v1.3, check them first: **U1** (pin 1 top-left, next to IO25), **Q1** (pin 1 bottom-left), **Q6** (pin 1 top-left), D1, D2, D5, C1, C3, C13. Then U2–U5, Q2–Q7, D3–D7, LED1 and the clamps (wire entry towards the board edge, J3/J4/J15 pin 1 at the left = DevKit USB end). Rotate in the preview if one differs |
| 6 Price | ≈ 26 "extended" part types (≈ $3 loading fee each, once per order) – normal for a board like this |

Out of stock? U1 → DRV8874QPWPRQ1 (C22448174, same pinout). U5 → SHT40-AD1F-R2 (C7461846) or SHT41-AD1F-R2 (C7461862), same address, with PTFE cap. KF250 clamp → same footprint family DG250-3.5 / WJ250-3.5 (check the drawing: Ø1.2 holes, 3.5 mm pitch, single row), or leave that line out and hand-solder. PTCs → same size, hold current and at least the same voltage.

## Parts to buy separately
| Part | Qty | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| ESP32 DevKitC V4, **WROOM** (not WROVER: GPIO16/17 are used), board 1.1 in (28 mm) or 1.0 in (25.4 mm) wide – not the narrow 0.9 in clone | 1 | Plugs into J3 + J4 (25.4 mm rows) or J3 + J15 (22.86 mm), USB-C to the left board edge |
| Power supply 12 V DC, **5 A** (e.g. Mean Well GST60A12); the 3 A GST36E12 still works for the standard actuator | 1 | 12 V IN clamp (via a DC-jack adapter) |
| Light barrier pair, 12–24 V DC, through-beam, **NPN**, **Light-ON** (often sold as "NC"), e.g. Omron E3Z-T61 set to L-ON. Dark-ON ("NO", e.g. E3F-5DN1) works too → `beam_inverted: "false"` | 1 | BEAM clamp |
| Leak detection: 2 stainless screws / bare wire ends 5–10 mm apart on the cabinet floor (nothing else needed), **or** a leak sensor with a digital output: NPN / open-collector (12 V or 3.3 V supply, plus a 10 kΩ resistor between the 3V3 and SIG poles) or 3.3–5 V logic module (LM393 type, 3.3 V supply, ≤ 50 mA) | 1 | LEAK clamp |
| Water valve 12 V DC, **≤ 3 A**, that **closes when powered** (normally-open solenoid or motorised ball valve "NO") | 1 | VALVE clamp (optional) |
| VL53L1X module | 1 | I2C clamp (optional) |

## Wiring
| Clamp | Pins (top → bottom / left → right) | Connect |
|---|---|---|
| 12 V IN | +12V, +12V, GND, GND | 12 V adapter → DC-jack adapter. Up to 5 A one +12V + one GND is enough, above 5 A use both pairs |
| ACTUATOR | M+, M− | Actuator (≤ 4.9 A). Door moves the wrong way → swap the 2 wires |
| FAN | 4-pin header | ARCTIC P12 Slim PWM plug |
| LED | 5V, DAT, GND | WS2812B strip / ring (DIN) |
| BUTTON | BTN, GND, 12V, LED− | Alu button: NO, C, LED+, LED− |
| REEDS | CL/GND, OP/GND, DR/GND | Door closed, door open, drawer reed |
| BEAM (left) | RX+, RX−, SIG, TX+, TX−, GND | Receiver: brown, blue, black. Emitter: brown, blue. Beam across the cabinet front, ≈ 12 cm in front of the door, ≈ 2 cm above the floor |
| LEAK (left) | 3V3, SIG, GND, 12V | Electrodes: SIG + GND (no polarity). Digital sensor: VCC → 3V3 (≤ 50 mA) or 12V, OUT → SIG (0–5 V only, never 12 V), GND; NPN / open collector: 10 kΩ between 3V3 and SIG. Wet = SIG low (NPN / active-low); active-high sensor → `leak_inverted: "true"` |
| VALVE (right) | 12V, VLV | Valve + → 12V, valve − → VLV (low side, flyback diode on board), ≤ 3 A |
| I2C ToF | 3V3, SDA, SCL, GND | VL53L1X module (optional) |

**Clamps:** push the button with a 2.5 mm screwdriver, insert the stripped wire (6–7 mm, 0.2–0.75 mm², ferrules OK) at 45° from the board edge, release.

## Pins (ESP32)
| GPIO | Function |
|---|---|
| 25 / 26 | DRV8874 IN1 (open) / IN2 (close), PWM mode |
| 32 / 33 / 18 | Reed door closed / door open / drawer |
| 19 | Clean button |
| 23 | Button ring (AO3400A, 12 V) |
| 16 | WS2812 data (74AHCT1G125 → 330 Ω) |
| 17 / 27 | Fan PWM (2N7002, inverted) / fan tach |
| 21 / 22 | I²C SDA / SCL (INA219 0x40 + SHT41 0x44 on board, VL53L1X on the clamp) |
| 34 | Light barrier input (via 2N7002, 12 V safe) |
| 13 | Light barrier emitter on/off (AO3400A) |
| 4 / 35 | Leak drive (pulsed 3.3 V through 100 k) / leak ADC (BAT54S clamp) |
| 2 | Valve (IRLTS6342 low side, 10 k pull-down: off at boot) |
| 15 | Buzzer (AO3400A, 10 k pull-down: off at boot) |
| 36 (VP) | 12 V rail ADC (100k / 22k, BAT54S clamp) |
| 14, 5, 39 (VN) | Spare on the EXP header J11 (not assembled); 39 = input only |

## Sensors, safety, alarms
| Item | How it works |
|---|---|
| Leak | Every 10 s IO4 drives 3.3 V through 100 k for 70 ms, IO35 reads SIG (dry electrodes ≈ 3.1 V, a digital sensor 0 V / 3.3 V). 3 wet readings in a row (25 s) → "Water leak" on, valve powered, red strobe, beep. Water gone → LED off after 60 s; **the valve stays powered until you switch it off in HA**. Tap water between two screws 5–10 mm apart reads well below 1 V; only very clean water (< 200 kΩ needed) could stay above the 2.2 V threshold → raise `leak_threshold` to 2.8 then. |
| Valve | Use a valve that closes when powered: a cut wire or a dead PSU cannot shut the water, but a leak does. F4 (4 A / 16 V PTC) protects the output. |
| Buzzer | Alerts in ESPHome via `rtttl.play`. "Buzzer" switch off → everything except the leak alarm is silent. |
| 12 V rail | "12 V rail" sensor (±0.3 V) and "Supply voltage low" when it sags below `supply_low` (weak PSU, stalled actuator). |
| SHT41 | Own island + vented case chamber → cabinet air. Set `offset` in the YAML after a check. Humidity can read low for 1–2 days after soldering. |
| Auto vent | Fan on above 65 %RH / 30 °C (HA numbers), 30–100 % speed; off 5 %RH / 1 °C below, and while the drawer is out. |
| Light barrier | Door does not close while the beam is blocked; broken while closing → stop + reopen. Self-test before every close and every 10 min (emitter off, receiver must react) → "Door beam fault". |
| Stall stop | INA219 motor current > `stall_current` (default 0.8 A) → stop. Stronger actuator: set it ≈ 0.3 A above the running current shown in HA ("Door motor current"). |

## Power
12 V in (6 A) → PTC 7 A → reverse-polarity P-FET → TVS 15 V → three branches: actuator (shunt → DRV8874, 4.9 A limit), valve (PTC 4 A), aux 12 V (PTC 1.1 A: fan, beam, leak; PTC 0.2 A: button LED). LMR51430 buck makes 5.1 V (3 A max) for the ESP32 (via Schottky, USB can stay plugged in), the LEDs (PTC 2 A) and the buzzer.

| PSU sizing (12 V side) | Current |
|---|---|
| Actuator (running) | as measured, e.g. 1.5 A (board limit 4.9 A) |
| Valve | as rated, e.g. 0.5 A (board limit 3 A) |
| 5 V side (ESP32 + 16 LEDs full white + buzzer) | ≈ 0.6 A |
| Fan + beam + button LED | ≈ 0.3 A |
| **Sum** | standard parts ≈ 3 A → 12 V / 5 A PSU; the board itself takes up to 6 A |

Keep LED brightness low (full white on all LEDs heats the buck).

# ESPHome config for the Robo-Garage controller PCB v1.3 (ESP32 DevKitC V4 plugged in)
# v1.1: SHT40 cabinet temperature / humidity (auto vent), door light barrier with self-test.
# v1.2: water leak input (LEAK clamp: electrodes or a digital sensor), buzzer, 12 V valve output (VALVE clamp),
# 12 V rail monitor on the ADC. DevKit USB-C is reachable through the case wall.
# v1.3: power headroom - DRV8874 motor driver (3 A moves, 4.9 A hardware current limit), 20 mOhm shunt,
# valve output 3 A, 12 V input 6 A. Same GPIOs and logic as v1.2, only the INA219 shunt / range changed.
# Pin changes vs. the module build: H-bridge IC instead of BTS7960 (no EN pin), INA219 on the board,
# fan tach on GPIO27, external pull-ups on reeds / button (internal pull-ups stay on, harmless).
substitutions:
  stall_current: "0.8"   # A: set ~0.3 A above the running current you see in HA ("Door motor current")
  beam_inverted: "true"  # NPN Light-ON receiver (recommended, often sold as "NC") = true; Dark-ON ("NO") = false.
                         # Check: beam clear -> HA "Door beam" must show "Clear". If not, flip this value.
  leak_threshold: "2.2"  # V at SIG: electrodes dry = 3.3 V, tap water between them < ~2 V; a digital sensor
                         # gives 0 V or 3.3 V (see "Leak probe")
  leak_inverted: "false" # false = wet when SIG is LOW (electrodes, NPN / open-collector or active-low sensors);
                         # true = wet when SIG is HIGH (active-high push-pull sensor)
  supply_low: "10.5"     # V: below this the 12 V supply is sagging (weak PSU, stalled actuator)

esphome:
  name: robo-garage
  friendly_name: Robo-Garage

esp32:
  board: esp32dev
  framework:
    type: esp-idf

logger:
api:
ota:
  - platform: esphome
wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password

i2c:
  sda: GPIO21          # pull-ups 4.7k on the PCB
  scl: GPIO22
  frequency: 100kHz

globals:
  - {id: beam_testing, type: bool, initial_value: "false"}   # emitter is off for the self-test
  - {id: beam_dark_ok, type: bool, initial_value: "true"}    # last self-test: receiver saw "no light"

output:
  - {platform: gpio, pin: GPIO4, id: leak_drive}              # v1.2: IO4 -> R40 100k -> leak probe (pulsed)
  - {platform: ledc, pin: {number: GPIO15, ignore_strapping_warning: true}, id: buzzer_pwm}  # v1.2: buzzer, R46 pull-down
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO25, id: door_open_out}          # DRV8874 IN1 -> actuator extends (PWM mode)
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO26, id: door_close_out}         # DRV8874 IN2 -> actuator retracts
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO23, id: btn_ring_out}           # AO3400A -> button ring (12 V)
  - {platform: ledc, pin: GPIO17, id: fan_pwm, frequency: 25000Hz, inverted: true}  # 2N7002 open drain

rtttl:
  id: buzzer
  output: buzzer_pwm

switch:
  - platform: gpio                                             # v1.3: IRLTS6342 low side -> VALVE clamp (12 V, <= 3 A)
    id: valve                                                  # on = valve powered. Use a valve that CLOSES when
    name: "Water valve"                                        # powered (normally-open solenoid / motorised valve),
    pin: {number: GPIO2, ignore_strapping_warning: true}        # then a leak powers it and the water is off. R43 pull-down.
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_OFF
    icon: mdi:valve
  - platform: template
    id: buzzer_enabled
    name: "Buzzer"                                             # off = silent (the leak alarm still beeps)
    optimistic: true
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_ON
    entity_category: config
  - platform: gpio                                             # AO3400A -> light barrier emitter (TX-)
    id: beam_tx
    pin: GPIO13
    restore_mode: ALWAYS_ON
    internal: true
  - platform: template
    id: vent_auto
    name: "Vent auto"                                          # off = fan only from HA / manual
    optimistic: true
    restore_mode: RESTORE_DEFAULT_ON
    entity_category: config
    on_turn_off:
      - fan.turn_off: rear_fan

number:
  - platform: template
    id: vent_hum_on
    name: "Vent humidity limit"
    unit_of_measurement: "%"
    min_value: 40
    max_value: 90
    step: 1
    initial_value: 65
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config
  - platform: template
    id: vent_temp_on
    name: "Vent temperature limit"
    unit_of_measurement: "°C"
    min_value: 20
    max_value: 45
    step: 0.5
    initial_value: 30
    optimistic: true
    restore_value: true
    entity_category: config

binary_sensor:
  - platform: template                                         # v1.2: LEAK clamp: 2 electrodes on the cabinet floor
                                                               # or a sensor with a digital output. Clamp poles: 3V3 (<= 50 mA),
                                                               # SIG (0-5 V), GND, 12V. NPN output: 10k between 3V3 and SIG.
    id: leak
    name: "Water leak"
    device_class: moisture
    lambda: |-
      if (std::isnan(id(leak_v).state)) return {};
      bool low = id(leak_v).state < ${leak_threshold};
      return ${leak_inverted} ? !low : low;
    filters: [delayed_on: 25s, delayed_off: 60s]               # 3 readings in a row (one every 10 s)
    on_press:
      - logger.log: "WATER LEAK -> valve powered, alarm"
      - switch.turn_on: valve
      - light.turn_on: {id: status_led, red: 100%, green: 0%, blue: 0%, effect: "Error strobe"}
      - rtttl.play: "leak:d=4,o=7,b=140:e,p,e,p,e,p,e,p,e,p,e"
    on_release:
      - light.turn_off: status_led                             # the valve stays powered until you switch it off in HA
  - platform: template                                         # v1.2: 12 V rail sagging (ADC on GPIO36)
    name: "Supply voltage low"
    device_class: problem
    lambda: return id(supply_v).state < ${supply_low};
    filters: [delayed_on: 2s, delayed_off: 5s]
  - {platform: gpio, id: door_closed_reed, name: "Door closed", pin: {number: GPIO32, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true}}
  - {platform: gpio, id: door_open_reed, name: "Door open", pin: {number: GPIO33, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true}}
  - {platform: gpio, id: drawer_reed, name: "Drawer", device_class: opening,
     pin: {number: GPIO18, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: false}}            # on = drawer out
  - {platform: gpio, name: "Clean button", pin: {number: GPIO19, mode: INPUT_PULLUP, inverted: true},
     filters: [delayed_on: 30ms]}
  - platform: template                                         # stall stop (INA219 on the PCB)
    id: door_stall
    name: "Door stall"
    lambda: return id(motor_current).state > ${stall_current};
    filters: [delayed_on: 400ms]                               # ignores the start-up inrush
    on_press:
      - cover.stop: door
      - logger.log: "Door stall -> stopped"
  # ---- light barrier (BEAM clamp): IO34 low = SIG high = receiver output off ----
  - platform: gpio
    id: beam_raw
    internal: true
    pin: {number: GPIO34, inverted: "${beam_inverted}"}       # input-only pin, pull-up R36 on the PCB
    filters: [delayed_on_off: 5ms]
    on_press:                                                  # unfiltered edge: beam broken while closing
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return !id(beam_testing) && id(door).current_operation == cover::COVER_OPERATION_CLOSING;'
          then:
            - logger.log: "Beam blocked while closing -> reopen"
            - cover.stop: door
            - delay: 300ms
            - cover.open: door
  - platform: template
    id: beam
    name: "Door beam"                                          # on = something in the door opening (HA display)
    device_class: occupancy
    lambda: |-
      if (id(beam_testing)) return {};                         // self-test running: keep the last state
      return id(beam_raw).state;
    filters: [delayed_off: 300ms]
  - platform: template
    id: beam_fault
    name: "Door beam fault"                                    # on = receiver did not react to the emitter
    device_class: problem

script:
  - id: beep_move                                              # 3 short beeps before the door moves
    mode: single
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            switch.is_on: buzzer_enabled
          then:
            - rtttl.play: "move:d=16,o=7,b=200:e,p,e,p,e"
  - id: beam_selftest                                          # emitter off -> receiver must report "no light"
    mode: single
    then:
      - lambda: 'id(beam_testing) = true;'
      - switch.turn_off: beam_tx
      - wait_until:                                            # receiver must drop out (max 0.5 s)
          condition:
            binary_sensor.is_on: beam_raw
          timeout: 500ms
      - lambda: 'id(beam_dark_ok) = id(beam_raw).state;'
      - switch.turn_on: beam_tx
      - wait_until:                                            # and see the beam again (max 1 s)
          condition:
            binary_sensor.is_off: beam_raw
          timeout: 1s
      - lambda: 'id(beam_testing) = false;'
      - binary_sensor.template.publish:
          id: beam_fault
          state: !lambda 'return !id(beam_dark_ok);'

sensor:
  - platform: adc                                              # v1.2: leak probe, read only while IO4 drives it
    id: leak_v
    name: "Leak probe"
    pin: GPIO35
    attenuation: 12db
    update_interval: never
    unit_of_measurement: V
    accuracy_decimals: 2
    entity_category: diagnostic
  - platform: adc                                              # v1.2: 100k / 22k divider on the 12 V rail
    id: supply_v
    name: "12 V rail"
    pin: GPIO36
    attenuation: 12db
    update_interval: 1s
    filters: [multiply: 5.545, sliding_window_moving_average: {window_size: 5, send_every: 5}]
    accuracy_decimals: 1
    unit_of_measurement: V
  - platform: ina219                                           # v1.3: on the PCB, shunt 20 mOhm (range 8 A)
    address: 0x40
    shunt_resistance: 0.02 ohm
    max_voltage: 16V
    max_current: 8A
    update_interval: 100ms
    current:
      name: "Door motor current"
      id: motor_current
    bus_voltage:
      name: "12 V supply"
  - platform: sht4x                                            # SHT41 (v1.3; SHT40 on older boards) on the island
    address: 0x44
    update_interval: 30s
    temperature:
      name: "Cabinet temperature"
      id: cab_temp
      filters: [offset: 0.0]                                   # set after a check with a reference thermometer
    humidity:
      name: "Cabinet humidity"
      id: cab_hum
  - platform: pulse_counter                                    # fan tach, 2 pulses per turn
    pin: {number: GPIO27, mode: INPUT_PULLUP}
    name: "Rear fan speed"
    unit_of_measurement: rpm
    filters: [multiply: 0.5]
    update_interval: 10s

fan:
  - {platform: speed, id: rear_fan, output: fan_pwm, name: "Rear fan"}

interval:
  - interval: 10s                                              # v1.2: leak probe, 70 ms of 3.3 V every 10 s (no corrosion)
    then:
      - output.turn_on: leak_drive
      - delay: 50ms
      - component.update: leak_v
      - delay: 20ms
      - output.turn_off: leak_drive
  - interval: 30s                                              # auto vent from the SHT41
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            switch.is_on: vent_auto
          then:
            - lambda: |-
                if (id(drawer_reed).state) {                       // drawer out: no fan while you work at the station
                  if (id(rear_fan).state) id(rear_fan).turn_off().perform();
                  return;
                }
                const float h = id(cab_hum).state, t = id(cab_temp).state;
                if (std::isnan(h) || std::isnan(t)) return;
                const float h_on = id(vent_hum_on).state, t_on = id(vent_temp_on).state;
                static bool running = false;
                if (h > h_on || t > t_on) running = true;
                else if (h < h_on - 5.0f && t < t_on - 1.0f) running = false;   // 5 %RH / 1 degC hysteresis
                if (!running) {
                  if (id(rear_fan).state) id(rear_fan).turn_off().perform();
                  return;
                }
                // 30 % at the switch-off point, 100 % at limit + 15 %RH or + 6 degC, in 10 % steps
                const float x = std::max((h - h_on + 5.0f) / 20.0f, (t - t_on + 1.0f) / 7.0f);
                const float s = 30.0f + 70.0f * std::min(std::max(x, 0.0f), 1.0f);
                const int speed = 10 * (int) roundf(s / 10.0f);
                if (!id(rear_fan).state || id(rear_fan).speed != speed)
                  id(rear_fan).turn_on().set_speed(speed).perform();
  - interval: 10min                                            # beam self-test while the door is idle
    then:
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return id(door).current_operation == cover::COVER_OPERATION_IDLE;'
          then:
            - script.execute: beam_selftest

cover:
  - platform: endstop
    id: door
    name: "Robo-Garage Door"
    device_class: garage
    open_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_close_out
      - script.execute: beep_move
      - output.turn_on: door_open_out
    open_endstop: door_open_reed
    open_duration: 11s
    close_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_open_out
      - script.execute: beep_move
      - script.execute: beam_selftest                          # 0.1-1.5 s before every close
      - script.wait: beam_selftest
      - if:
          condition:
            lambda: 'return id(beam_dark_ok) && !id(beam_raw).state;'   # sensor works and beam is clear
          then:
            - output.turn_on: door_close_out
          else:
            - logger.log: "Door stays open: beam blocked or beam fault"
            - cover.open: door                                 # back to fully open (no-op if already open)
    close_endstop: door_closed_reed
    close_duration: 11s
    max_duration: 15s
    stop_action:
      - output.turn_off: door_open_out
      - output.turn_off: door_close_out

light:
  - {platform: monochromatic, name: "Clean button ring", output: btn_ring_out}
  - platform: esp32_rmt_led_strip
    id: status_led
    name: "Robo-Garage Status LED"
    pin: GPIO16                                                # via 74AHCT1G125 level shifter
    num_leds: 16
    chipset: WS2812
    channel_colors: GRB
    effects:
      - pulse: {name: "Slow pulse", transition_length: 1s, update_interval: 1s}
      - strobe: {name: "Error strobe"}
      - addressable_scan: {name: "Chase"}
      - addressable_color_wipe: {name: "Spinner"}

# Robo-Garage controller PCB - parts, footprints, nets, placement, LCSC numbers (single source of truth)
# Coordinates in mm, KiCad board coords (x right, y down); board 100 x 100 mm, top-left at (0, 0).
# rot = KiCad footprint rotation in degrees (CCW).

VERSION = '1.3'   # PCB version: silkscreen title + release zip name (pcb/gen/package.sh)

W, H = 100.0, 100.0

# ---- ESP32 DevKitC V4, v1.2: USB-C at the LEFT board edge (plug in through the case wall), antenna end inboard
# over a copper keep-out. Rotated 180 deg vs. v1.1: top row = DevKit J2 side (5V .. 3V3), bottom rows = J3 side
# (CLK .. GND), pin 19 of the DevKit (USB end) sits in socket pin 1 at x = 1.7, dual column 22.86 / 25.4 mm.
J3_PINS = ['GND', 'IO23', 'IO22', 'TXD', 'RXD', 'IO21', 'GND', 'IO19', 'IO18', 'IO5', 'IO17', 'IO16', 'IO4',
           'IO0', 'IO2', 'IO15', 'SD1', 'SD0', 'CLK']
J2_PINS = ['+3V3', 'EN', 'VP', 'VN', 'IO34', 'IO35', 'IO32', 'IO33', 'IO25', 'IO26', 'IO27', 'IO14', 'IO12',
           'GND', 'IO13', 'SD2', 'SD3', 'CMD', '+5V_DEV']
# VP = GPIO36, VN = GPIO39 (input only, ADC1). v1.2 adds IO2 (valve), IO15 (buzzer), VP (12 V monitor),
# IO35 (leak probe, ADC1), VN + IO5 (EXP header spares).
USED = {'GND', 'IO23', 'IO22', 'IO21', 'IO19', 'IO18', 'IO17', 'IO16', 'IO4', '+3V3', 'IO32', 'IO33', 'IO25',
        'IO26', 'IO27', 'IO14', 'IO13', '+5V_DEV', 'IO34', 'IO35', 'IO2', 'IO15', 'VP', 'VN', 'IO5'}
DK_X0, DK_Y0 = 1.7, 5.0         # socket pin 1 (DevKit USB end); the USB-C face ends up 1.0 mm outside the board edge
ANT_KEEPOUT = [(50.3, 0.5, 60.0, 36.5)]   # no copper / tracks under the module antenna (x 49..55); a 2 mm corridor
                                           # stays open between the socket ends (48.7) and the zone for the power tracks
ROW_NARROW, ROW_WIDE = 22.86, 25.4


def j_top_nets():      # DevKit J2 side, reversed: socket pin 1 = 5V (USB end) ... pin 19 = 3V3 (antenna end)
    return {str(k + 1): (n if n in USED else None) for k, n in enumerate(reversed(J2_PINS))}


def j_bot_nets():      # DevKit J3 side, reversed: socket pin 1 = CLK (USB end) ... pin 19 = GND (antenna end)
    return {str(k + 1): (n if n in USED else None) for k, n in enumerate(reversed(J3_PINS))}


R0603 = ('Resistor_SMD', 'R_0603_1608Metric')
C0603 = ('Capacitor_SMD', 'C_0603_1608Metric')
C0805 = ('Capacitor_SMD', 'C_0805_2012Metric')

       '2.2k': 'C4190', '75k': 'C23242', '22k': 'C31850', '1.5k': 'C22843'}

# v1.2: spring clamps Cixi Kefa KF250-3.5-nP-1 (3.5 mm pitch, 45 deg, push buttons, 0.2-0.75 mm2, 5 A),
# JLC extended parts, wave soldered by JLC (Economic PCBA). Footprint: pcb/lib/robo.pretty (fplib.py).
KF_LCSC = {2: 'C475154', 3: 'C475155', 4: 'C475156', 6: 'C475158'}


def kf(n):
    return ('robo', 'KF250-3.5-%dP_1x%02d_P3.50mm_45Degree' % (n, n))


P = {}


def add(ref, fp, val, x, y, rot, nets, lcsc=None, mpn=None, **kw):
    if lcsc is None:
        lcsc = RES.get(val) if fp == R0603 else CAP.get(val)
    P[ref] = dict(lib=fp[0], fp=fp[1], val=val, x=x, y=y, rot=rot, nets=nets, lcsc=lcsc, mpn=mpn, **kw)


def R(ref, val, x, y, rot, a, b):
    add(ref, R0603, val, x, y, rot, {'1': a, '2': b})


def C(ref, val, x, y, rot, a, b, fp=C0603):
    add(ref, fp, val, x, y, rot, {'1': a, '2': b})


def clamp(ref, n, val, x, y, rot, nets):
    add(ref, kf(n), val, x, y, rot, nets, lcsc=KF_LCSC[n], mpn='KF250-3.5-%dP-1' % n, tht=True)
